summary: A Yes vote establishes a one-cent (1%) sales tax providing about $6,000,000 annually for city services including public safety.

tax.text: A Yes vote supports a one-cent local sales tax to fund police, fire, and other core city services.
tax.quote: If enacted by Lincoln voters, Measure F would enact a one-cent local sales tax, providing $6,000,000 annually to maintain police, fire, and other core City services with funds that cannot be taken by the State.

tax.text: A No vote would reject Measure F’s proposed one-cent sales tax increase.
tax.quote: A “no” vote on Measure F will not authorize the one cent (1¢) sales tax.
